title: Totally recommend, beautiful night and one I will certainly remember about our trip to Barcelona.
text: Fantastic night, skipper was lovely, saxophonist made it even more special. Totally recommend this experience. Only two things I would recommend- ice as drinks got hot as it was a warm night and eat before hand as tapas were minimal. Easy to organise and great communication leading up to it.
author: Melinda_D

title: Wonderful sunset sail with Manu
text: Wonderful trip with Manu. Great drinks and appetizers. Manu was wonderful and we had a great experience with him for our family/friends of 9. Worth booking and the price was great.
author: Jennifer_M

title: Best bachelorette cruise !!!
text:
The highlight of our trip to Barcelona was definitely this cruise. 
To start with we had the best skipper who was very patient with us dancing and celebrating all time long! The boat was amazing very comfortable even though we were 10 women and the drinks refreshing. We took the 3hr sunset cruise which I suggest as you will need as much time as possible to enjoy it and because the sunset is pure magic.  Thanks again to our skipper Sergio and of course the amazing organisation of this cruise!!!
author: Effrosyni_C

title: Perfect trip
text: Amazing experience. Eduardo was a fantastic captain and host. We all had a brilliant time. Highly recommended.
author: B4142YRandrews

title: Trip of a lifetime
text: We loved our captain, Sergio, and the entire experience. We will never forget this amazing night on the Mediterranean!
author: Jodie_M

title: Great experience
text: Great experience. Amazing views of the city. Captain was very friendly and explained much of what Barcelona has to offer.
author: Patric_B

title: Amazing Experience!
text: What a great way to celebrate my birthday on board of a boat with my friends in Barcelona. The private option gave us the opportunity to enjoy a unique experience. 100% recommended!

title: Great experience at sea
text: A great experience from Vicky. Very attentive at all times and very professional. They offer you a snack watching the sunset. The weather accompanied us a lot and being able to sail with that boat is a joy. We'll repeat with friends for sure
